tips.text: Start the Solaris United rank-ups first; the standing wait is the real bottleneck, not the bounty blueprints.
Do not farm all three part blueprints on day one; the Systems part still waits on Rank 4 standing for Marquise Thyst.
Skip spending a Circuit pick on Garuda; the bounty blueprints drop quickly anyway.
Stop at the Level 20-40 bounty; nothing harder improves the part odds.
Treat Garuda as a mid-game frame; solo Fortuna alerts at low progress can kill you in minutes, so bring a squad.
Keep your Toroids; do not trade them to Little Duck until Garuda is built, since you need 2 of each colour.
Finish The War Within before building the frame; Kuva Siphons and Floods are how you get the 3,500 Kuva.
Expect the part drops to be painless; the resource checklist is what people complain about.
Budget about six hours from zero blueprints, plus the Solaris United standing wait.
